summary: Specifies an RTP payload format for Extended Adaptive Multi-Rate Wideband (AMR-WB+) audio. AMR-WB+ extends the AMR-WB speech codec with new frame types for high-quality music as well as speech. A media type registration is included. It is standards-track.

eli5.summary: A sound squeezer that handles both talking and music. This says how to pack the squeezed sound into internet packets.
